about: For years, Craig and Doreen Wambolt escaped the snowy New England winters by bringing their three children to Florida’s Space Coast — a place where the sand meets the surf and family memories come easily. They fell in love with Melbourne Beach, where they could spend mornings on the water and still be just a short drive from Orlando’s world-famous parks and attractions.

In 2020, the Wambolts made Melbourne their permanent home and set out to share the very experience that had brought their family so much joy. From that vision, The Florida Havens was born — a collection of private, oceanfront homes designed for families to reconnect, relax, and create lifelong memories.

The Havens at Beach Street welcomed its first guests in 2023, offering two luxury homes just steps from the shore. Two years later, The Havens at The Dunes opened in the spring of 2025, expanding the experience with another pair of beautifully appointed seaside retreats.
Today, The Florida Havens continues the Wambolts’ family tradition — where beachside serenity meets the excitement of nearby Orlando, and every stay feels like coming home to the coast.

stay-near-space-coast-rocket-launches-ke: Rocket Launches, NASA & Why This Area Is Called “The Space Coast”
When you stay at The Florida Havens, you’re not just visiting the beach — you’re staying in one of the most historically significant space regions in the world.
Florida’s Space Coast earned its name because it is home to Kennedy Space Center, Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, and some of the most important rocket launches in American history.
From Apollo moon missions to today’s SpaceX Falcon 9 launches, this stretch of coastline continues to make history — and you can often watch it happen live during your stay.
Located about 1 hour north of Melbourne Beach, the Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex is one of Florida’s most inspiring attractions.
Stand beneath the massive Saturn V rocket
Visit the Space Shuttle Atlantis exhibit
Learn about Artemis missions and future moon exploration
It’s an unforgettable experience for families, space enthusiasts, and anyone curious about America’s space legacy. 📍 Location: Merritt Island, FL
🚀 Watch Real Rocket Launches During Your Stay
One of the most unique aspects of visiting the Space Coast is the opportunity to witness live rocket launches from:
Depending on weather and schedule, launches can often be seen from beaches near our properties — sometimes even from your vacation rental.
There’s nothing quite like watching a rocket ascend into the sky over the Atlantic Ocean.
You can check the current launch schedule here:
🌊 Best Local Rocket Launch Viewing Spots
Clear evenings and early mornings provide spectacular viewing conditions.
🧑‍🚀 American Space Museum & Space Walk of Fame:
Located in nearby Titusville, the American Space Museum & Space Walk of Fame offers a more intimate, insider look at the people and technology behind America’s space program.
Authentic artifacts from the Mercury, Gemini, Apollo and Shuttle programs
Mission control equipment and launch hardware
Personal stories from NASA and aerospace professionals

🐢 Archie Carr National Wildlife Refuge (Sea Turtle Nesting)

One of the most special features of staying in Melbourne Beach is proximity to the Archie Carr National Wildlife Refuge — one of the most important sea turtle nesting habitats in the Western Hemisphere.

From May through October, thousands of sea turtles come ashore to nest along these protected beaches. Guests staying at The Florida Havens often witness nesting activity or hatchlings making their way to the ocean (with proper guidelines and respect for wildlife).
It’s a rare and unforgettable natural experience that makes The Florida Havens truly unique.

🏟️ About The USSSA Space Coast Complex

The USSSA Space Coast Complex in Viera, FL is recognized as one of the nation’s top youth sports facilities — hosting major baseball and softball tournaments throughout the year. With 15 all-turf fields, multi-purpose stadiums, and a variety of events for athletes of all ages, it’s a hub for competitive play and family gatherings alike.
Families travel from across the U.S. to witness and participate in marquee USSSA events like:
Space Coast World Series – National championships for ages 8U–18U (June each year)
Space Coast Spring Games – Multi-week youth tournament festival
Florida Slowpitch & Challenge Cups – Competitive youth and adult events
Fastpitch All American Games – Showcase opportunities for elite players (summer)
Space Coast Invitational tournaments and other regional competitions
👉 These tournaments often draw hundreds of teams, coaches, and fans — making the Space Coast one of the most dynamic sports travel destinations in Florida.
